title: Information-Theoretic Scaling Laws of Neural Quantum States
summary: We establish an information-theoretic scaling law for generic autoregressive neural quantum states, determined by the middle-cut mutual information of the wavefunction amplitude. By formalizing the virtual bond as an effective information channel across a sequence bipartition, we rigorously prove that exact autoregressive representation of a quantum state requires the virtual-bond dimension to scale with the amplitude mutual information.
